title: Icons
slide_intent: Match icons to their function because a decorative symbol may fail when someone relies on it to navigate or operate a service.
strategic_value: Purpose-specific icon families can keep Helsinki communication coherent without sacrificing functional clarity.
demonstration: This webpage introduction distinguishes three icon purposes and says all types may illustrate, but signage and user-interface functions require icons designed for those roles.
practical_value: Choose the icon family by intended function before choosing its subject.

content_islands.name: Icon roles
content_islands.spec: Keep the simplified-message premise and three-purpose boundary together.

ingredient.name: Purpose-specific icons
ingredient.role: Communicate simplified messages appropriate to the task.
ingredient.application: Use any type for illustration, but use designated signage or UI icons for those functions.
ingredient.scope: Three icon purposes; permission for illustration does not extend to functional substitution.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text connects icons to simplified messages, scalability and consistent style.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Only icons designed for signage or user interfaces may serve those respective purposes.
